question: Where is the nearest nature reserve positioned in the northeast direction of Broadbent Arena, Louisville, KY?
sql: SELECT P.park_name FROM parks AS P, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Broadbent Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Louisville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 ) AS Arena WHERE P.leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(Arena.geometry, P.geometry)) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5 ORDER BY ST_Distance(Arena.geometry::geography, P.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;

metadata.final_exec_err: ST_Azimuth(geography, geography) is only valid for point inputs
